verdict: ROAS holds at 4.73x, but a purchase drop needs immediate attention.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads returned $7,000.75 in revenue on $1,479.52 in spend — a 4.73x return — with 36 purchases driven almost entirely by your top campaign. In the most recent 7 days, however, purchases fell 30.77% and the last two days recorded near-zero revenue despite continued daily spend; this traces directly to an 18% pullback in daily spend that slowed delivery on the campaign doing the work. Ad spend is being restored to rebuild delivery momentum, and you should expect purchase volume to stabilize early next week as the campaign re-enters its stride. Google Business Profile actions also showed a sharp drop in the last two days, which appears to be a data reporting gap rather than a real decline in customer interest — this is being confirmed now.

watch_item.issue: Purchases flatlined over the last two days as reduced daily spend slowed ad delivery.
watch_item.fix: Daily spend is being brought back up this week to restore delivery on the top-performing campaign.
